slots.notes: Fullscreen looping muted autoplaying hero background video, fixed inset-0 object-cover at z-index 0 behind everything; the only media in the page and the sole source of all visual depth/color behind the black base and glass UI.

mechanic: A single non-scrolling full-viewport hero where a fixed looping background video sits under a bottom-only backdrop-blur mask, a liquid-glass navbar, and a bottom-anchored cinematic content block whose every element staggers in via a blur-fade-up (blur + opacity + translateY) reveal cascading from 0ms to 900ms.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS with Lucide React icons; Inter from Google Fonts; liquid-glass, the bottom blur mask, and the blurFadeUp keyframe are hand-authored CSS with stagger delays applied as inline animationDelay styles.
reskinNotes: Liquid-glass bakes white rgba gradient stops, an inset white highlight, and a border-only ::before mask (-webkit-mask-composite: xor / mask-composite: exclude) tuned for a light rim on a dark video, so it only reads correctly on dark themes. The bottom blur overlay relies on a mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, black 0%, transparent 45%) with -webkit- prefix and applies blur without any dark gradient, so legibility depends on the video being light at the bottom. Title uses a font-metric-dependent letter-spacing (-0.04em) tuned to Inter that will need retuning for a substitute display font. All copy, the five nav labels, and the three IMDB/duration/date metadata badges are hardcoded in markup, and the staggered animationDelay values are inline per element rather than tokenized, so re-ordering or adding elements means hand-editing delays.
